item.title: Iranian tennis player withdraws from match against Israeli opponent
item.description: Tehran, IRNA — Ali Yazdani, an Iranian tennis player, withdrew from the men’s doubles quarterfinals of the ITF World Tennis Tour in Antalya, Türkiye, to avoid playing an opponent from the Israeli regime.

item.title: Iran’s Italy embassy warns against efforts to draw Europe into regional crisis following Kuwait attack
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s embassy in Rome has rejected allegations that Iran was responsible for a drone attack on a military facility in Kuwait that killed two Italian nationals, warning against attempts to widen the regional conflict and draw Europe into it.
